text:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident triggered INC-4420001 — service: embed-service-canary, symptom: 5xx rate spike in canary rollout (v2.14). Paging rotation: jordan (oncall). Link: https://pd.internal/INC-4420001 :rotating_light:

jordan (oncall): acked — I'm on. pulling up dashboards now.

anya (sre): seeing p95 and p99 spikes and a 502/503 surge from embed-service-canary. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/embed-canary. rolling avg error ~9% on canary pods, prod (non-canary) looks stable. @sam can you grab canary pod logs?

sam (backend): pulling logs now. multiple tokenizer init failures with memory errors right after rollout. log snippet:
```
E Tokenizer failed to allocate buffer: runtime: out of memory
at tokenizer.init()
stack: goroutine 23 [running]
```
Also saw kernel OOM/killed messages on gpu-node-18.

devbot: deploy-bot: canary rollout v2.14 started 2024-11-02T21:12:00Z — target 10% traffic.

lina (prod): customer impact: enterprise customers on dedicated endpoints reported intermittent 503s, tickets rising. support ticket TICKET-789 opened and linked.

jordan (oncall): triage plan (short): 1) cut canary traffic to 0% 2) drain/cordon affected node 3) rollback to v2.13 if errors persist. I'll start with cutting traffic.

sam (backend): applying traffic-split patch to service mesh to route 100% to v2.13:
```
kubectl -n inference patch virtualservice embed-svc --type merge --patch '{"spec":{"http":[{"route":[{"destination":{"host":"embed-svc","subset":"v2-13","weight":100}}] }]}}'
```

anya (sre): also cordoning the noisy node and draining to avoid repeated OOMs: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-18 && kubectl drain gpu-node-18 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

devbot: deploy-bot: traffic updated -> canary weight 0% (v2.14) at 2024-11-02T21:25:12Z

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT reassigned to sam (backend) for investigation. Escalation level: high.

sam (backend): rolling back embed-service to v2.13 now: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/embed-service --to-revision=3` — watching rollout status.

jordan (oncall): monitoring metrics and error rate. @lina please update CS with rollback note and ETA.

lina (prod): updated customer comms: "We rolled back a canary that caused intermittent 503s; engineers are monitoring." CS ticket updated with rollback timestamp and links.

devbot: deployment rollback completed at 2024-11-02T21:33:05Z — rollout status: success (all pods on v2.13).

anya (sre): metrics trending back to baseline, error rate <0.1% now. Confirming GPU memory pressure reduced after draining node. Will tag incident for postmortem and start RCA.

sam (backend): preliminary RCA: a tokenizer change in v2.14 increases peak GPU memory reservation for certain long-sequence inputs; in canary it exceeded node allocation causing OOM/kills. Plan: revert high-allocation path and add a guard/feature flag + synthetic load test for long sequences. Filing PR and test plan.

jordan (oncall): marking pager resolved for rotation. Leaving notes: traffic cut, rollback, node drained. Handoff: next oncall is morgan in 2h.

morgan (oncall-2): i'm on deck for the next 2 hours. ping me if anything regresses. :eyes:

pagerduty-bot: INC-4420001 status: resolved at 2024-11-02T21:46:00Z

---
Notes/links: runbook: https://runbooks.internal/embed-service-canary, support ticket: TICKET-789, postmortem template: https://docs.internal/postmortems.
Actions: sam will open PR with feature-flag + tests; anya will own postmortem; jordan will add timeline and commands used to incident doc.
